title: Protect or unlock PDF
description: Passwords are entered in password widgets and travel only in the request's secrets, never in params (spec section 7.3).

userPassword.title: Password to open
userPassword.description: Collected by the form and moved into secrets.userPassword by the core. The adapter rejects it as a param.

ownerPassword.title: Permissions password (optional)
ownerPassword.description: Moved into secrets.ownerPassword by the core. If absent, a random one is generated and never stored or shown.

permissions.title: Allow
permissions.description: PDF viewers honor these voluntarily; they are not real access control.

confirmRights.title: I have the right to remove these restrictions
confirmRights.description: Required to unlock a file that has only a permissions password.
